### Observed differences

In the later window, activity A27 appears in about 99% of traces (up from about 61%), while activities A32, A33, A38 and A39 each appear in about 1–2% of traces (down from about 39% each). [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005]  
The outgoing transitions of A26 shift from a split (about 59% to A27, and roughly 8–11% each to A32, A33, A38, A39) to almost exclusively to A27 (about 96%). [DIR001]  
A27 and A28 co-occur in about 99% of traces (up from 61%), with A27 preceding A28 in about 95% (up from 60%). [REL011]  
The lag between A26 and A28 shortens: before, about 60% had a lag of 2 and 36% a lag of 5; after, about 95% have a lag of 2. [LAG002]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a structural change in the process. The observed differences all point to a single underlying change—the near-disappearance of a branch containing A32, A33, A38 and A39—but the number of distinct differences (one) is not clearly larger than the 0.81 items expected by chance under no change. [screening]

REL006 shows A26 and A27 cooccurrence 0.61 before, 0.99 after. A26 is present in all traces? REL006 before: A_only 0.39, B_only 0, neither 0, so A26 present in 100%? Wait A_only 0.39 means A26 present, A27 absent. B_only 0, neither 0, so A26 present in all 200. After: A_only 0.01, B_only 0, neither 0, so A26 present in all. So A26 always present. Actually cooccurrence 0.465 + A_only 0.005 = 0.47. Before A19 present in 0.355+0.225=0.58. So A19 decreases from 0.58 to 0.47. But not as dramatic. A27 increases. Also A19 before A27? A_before_B 0.355 before, 0.45 after. But A19 is before A27 in cooccurring cases. Not central.

REL016 before: A_only 0, B_only 0.39, neither 0, so A42 present in all? B_only 0.39 means A27 absent, A42 present. So A42 present in all 200. After: B_only 0.01, so A42 present in 0.99+0.01? cooccurrence 0.99 + B_only 0.01 = 1.0. So A42 always present. So A42 is a stable activity that occurs before A27. So the branch after A26: before, A26 went to A27 (60%) or to A32/A33/A38/A39 (40%). After, A26 goes to A27 (96%). So the alternative branch is removed.
